sections.Profile:
Road Runner, developed by Atari Incorporated in 1979, is a widebody pinball machine themed after the popular Looney Tunes cartoon character. Road Runner was designed by Marty Rosenthal.

- Manufacturer: Atari Incorporated
- Years made: 1979
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Prototype, Licensed, Cartoon, 1970s, Solid State
sections.Editions: - Road Runner: 2 made, released 1979-01-01, Atari Generation/System 3
